heading: Sec. 1-1. - How Code designated and cited.
text:
The ordinances embraced in the following chapters and sections shall constitute and
be designated "The Municipal Code of Hartford" and may be so cited. The Code may also
be cited as "Hartford City Code".

(Code 1977, § 1-1)

Charter reference—
Codification required, Ch. III, § 13.

heading: Sec. 1-2. - Definitions; rules of construction.
text:
In the construction of this Code, and of all ordinances, the following rules shall
be observed, unless such construction would be inconsistent with the manifest intent
of the council:

Assisted project. "Assisted project" shall mean any commercial development which receives any public
subsidy, including but not limited to tax abatements, tax fixing agreements, public
bonds, public grants, and public land or easements sold or otherwise conveyed for
the benefit of the development for less than the appraised fair market value as determined
as of the date of transfer, and which shall not be located in an enterprise zone.

Bond. When a bond is required, an undertaking in writing shall be sufficient.

Certified mail. In all cases in the Code where the words "registered mail" appear they shall mean
"registered or certified mail".

City. The words "the city" shall mean the City of Hartford in the County of Hartford and
State of Connecticut.

Commercial development. "Commercial development" shall mean any plant, building, office building, other real
property improvement, or part thereof, which is newly constructed or substantially
renovated or expanded and which is to be used primarily for manufacturing uses; office,
general and professional use; service uses; and trade uses as set out in section 35-853
of the municipal code. A commercial development shall not include any project with
a gross building floor area not exceeding forty thousand (40,000) square feet nor
any project specifically excluded by a majority vote of the council.

Computation of time. Whenever a notice is required to be given or an act to be done a certain length of
time before any proceeding shall be had, the day on which such notice is given or
such act is done shall be counted in computing the time, but the day on which such
proceeding is to be had shall not be counted.

Council. The word "council" shall mean the court of common council of the City of Hartford.

County. The words "the county" shall mean the County of Hartford in the State of Connecticut.

Delegation of authority. Whenever a provision appears requiring the head of a department or other officer of
the city to do some act or perform some duty, or granting some right to him as such
official, it shall be construed to authorize such department head or officer to designate,
delegate and authorize subordinates to do the required act or perform the required
duty, or it shall grant to them such right, unless the terms of the provision designate
otherwise.

Developer. "Developer" shall mean any person, nonprofit corporation, business corporation, partnership,
limited partnership, joint venture, trust, association or other persons or organizations
having as one (1) of its or their purposes the construction, rehabilitation, ownership
or operation of commercial buildings.

Floor area. "Floor area" shall have the same meaning as set out in section 35-2 of the Municipal Code.

Gender. A word importing the masculine gender only shall extend and be applied to females
and to firms, partnerships and corporations as well as to males, and words importing
the feminine gender may apply to males.

General statutes. The words "general statutes" shall mean the most recent revision of the general statutes
of the State of Connecticut, as from time to time amended.

Joint authority. Words purporting to give authority to several persons shall be construed as giving
such authority to a majority of such persons.

Linkage trust fund. "Linkage trust fund" shall mean an account to collect and disburse moneys raised for
the purposes of such fund.

Minority. "Minority" shall mean a person listed in one (1) of the categories defined in section 2-548(c)(1)—(4).

Month. The word "month" shall mean a calendar month.

Number. A word importing the singular number only may extend and be applied to several persons
and things as well as to one (1) person and thing, and a word importing the plural
number may apply to one (1) person or thing.

Oath. The word "oath" shall be construed to include an affirmation in all cases in which
by law an affirmation may be substituted for an oath, and in such cases the words
"swear" and "sworn" shall be equivalent to the words "affirm" and "affirmed."

Office developer. "Office developer" shall mean any developer of an office development.

Office developments. "Office developments" shall mean any commercial developments, not located in a designated
enterprise zone, used primarily for office purposes, not including medical, educational
or retail use.

Owner. The word "owner," applied to a building or land, shall include any part owner, joint
owner, tenant in common, tenant in partnership, or joint tenant of the whole or of
a part of such building or land.

Person; another. The words "person" and "another" may extend and be applied to communities, companies,
corporations, public or private, societies and associations.

Preceding, following. The words "preceding" and "following" shall mean next before and next after, respectively.

Shall; may. The word "shall" is held to be mandatory; "may" shall be held to be permissive.

Sidewalk. The word "sidewalk" shall mean any portion of the street, usually lying on either
side thereof, between the curb and the adjacent street line, intended for the use
of pedestrians.

Signature, subscription. The word "signature" or "subscription" shall include a mark when a person cannot write.

State. The word "state" shall mean the State of Connecticut.

Street. The word "street" shall be construed to embrace streets, avenues, boulevards, highways,
roads, alleys, lanes, viaducts, bridges and the approaches thereto, and all other
public thoroughfares in the city and shall mean all that part thereof from street
line to street line of the premises abutting thereon.

Tense. Words used in the past or present tense shall include the future as well as the past
and present.

Town. The words "the town" shall mean the Town of Hartford, in the County of Hartford and
State of Connecticut.

Written, in writing. The term "written" or "in writing" shall be construed to include any representation
of words, letters or figures, whether by printing or otherwise.

Year. The word "year" shall mean a calendar year.

(Code 1977, § 1-3; Ord. No. 20-86, 6-23-86; Ord. No. 30-87, 9-28-87)

State Law reference—
Rules of construction for statutory purposes, G.S. § 1-1 et seq.

heading: Sec. 1-3. - Liberal construction of Code.
text:
All general provisions, terms, phrases and expressions in the Code and ordinances
shall be liberally construed in order that the true intent and meaning of the council
may be fully carried out.

(Code 1977, § 1-3; Ord. No. 20-86, 6-23-86)
